<a id="identity_table"></a>
### [`identity_table`](../../../../src/protection/identity_table.asm#L6) `$1000-$10DC`

*data*

Identity table $00-$ff: the crack's replacement for the table the original loader leaves at $d100 (see $5ed8).
Game start ($42dc) reads it as the start value of engine_damage (0).

- **Read by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start) [`$42DC`](../../../../src/init/game_start.asm#L190)

<a id="identity_table_dd"></a>
### [`identity_table_dd`](../../../../src/protection/identity_table.asm#L21) `$10DD-$10FF`

*data*

The status IRQ ($456d) reads it as the raster line $dd to wait for.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame) [`$456D`](../../../../src/irq/frame_irq.asm#L7)
